services.desc: Brian “Rocket” Rock and Gizzae are a longtime force in the Chicago reggae scene, known for high-energy performances and an authentic island-inspired sound. Rocket began performing professionally at age 12 in Dominica and later became the lead vocalist for The Swinging Stars before moving to New York City, where he co-founded Moja Nya and worked as a session musician on major projects including Born in the U.S.A. and Too Much Blood. After relocating to Chicago, Rocket formed Gizzae, serving as lead vocalist, bassist, and songwriter.
